name: b4x-intellisense
description: Comprehensive IDE companion for the B4X family (B4A, B4i, B4J, B4R). Provides a complete developer toolkit for Visual Studio Code including a local LSP backend and fast workspace indexer with optional prebuilt API index. Delivers advanced language features (contextual completions, hover, go-to-definition, rename, signature help), cross-file type inference, persistent on-disk indexing with safe atomic writes and migrations, XML and library discovery, project-aware configuration via .b4a/.b4i/.b4j/.b4r files, and server-side refactor actions (Extract Method with preview). Includes diagnostics, code actions, platform INI/theme import, VS Code commands for project management, and an offline-first design that gracefully falls back to live workspace and installed libraries when a bundled API index is not present.

commands.title: B4X: Import Theme From B4X Install

b4xIntellisense.b4aIniPath.description: Path to the B4A b4xV5.ini file. Leave empty to auto-detect from %APPDATA%\Anywhere Software\Basic4android\b4xV5.ini.

b4xIntellisense.b4iIniPath.description: Optional path to the B4I b4xV5.ini file for platform-aware folder loading.

b4xIntellisense.b4jIniPath.description: Optional path to the B4J b4xV5.ini file for platform-aware folder loading.

b4xIntellisense.b4rIniPath.description: Optional path to the B4R b4xV5.ini file for platform-aware folder loading.

b4xIntellisense.b4aInstallPath.description: Optional installation folder of B4A to locate Themes and other assets.

b4xIntellisense.b4iInstallPath.description: Optional installation folder of B4i to locate Themes and other assets.

b4xIntellisense.b4jInstallPath.description: Optional installation folder of B4J to locate Themes and other assets.

b4xIntellisense.b4rInstallPath.description: Optional installation folder of B4R to locate Themes and other assets.

b4xIntellisense.fontFamily.description: Font family used by extension webviews and previews.

b4xIntellisense.fontSize.description: Font size (px) used by extension webviews and previews.

b4xIntellisense.wordWrap.description: When true use word wrap in extension webviews/previews.

b4xIntellisense.tabSize.description: Tab size used by extension webviews/previews.

b4xIntellisense.autoApplyIni.description: Controls automatic application of Font/Theme hints from platform INI. 'prompt' will ask, 'always' applies silently, 'never' ignores INI hints.

b4xIntellisense.autoAddProjectFolderOnOp.description: When true the extension will add the project folder as a workspace folder when opening a B4X project. Useful when running Extension Host for testing.

b4xIntellisense.autoOpenProjectFolderOnO.description: When true the extension will open the project folder in the window (replacing the current workspace) when opening a B4X project. Only enable if you want to switch the window to the project folder automatically.

b4xIntellisense.autoLoadProjectAssets.description: When true the extension will automatically load project assets (libraries, modules, start language server) after a B4X project is opened.

b4xIntellisense.disableConsoleOutput.description: When true disables all console.log/console.warn/console.error output; use log file for all diagnostics.

b4xIntellisense.autoBackupInterval.description: Auto-backup interval in milliseconds. Default 600000 = 10 minutes.

b4xIntellisense.extractMethod.previewBeh.description: Controls Extract Method preview behavior: 'prompt' shows a preview and asks, 'autoApply' applies edits without prompting, 'alwaysPreview' always opens the preview but does not auto-apply.

b4xIntellisense.enableTelemetry.description: Enable anonymous telemetry for basic feature usage (opt-in).

b4xIntellisense.debug.description: When true, the extension appends a timestamped log file (b4x-log-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.txt) containing debug entries for extension actions.

scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && npx vsce package
